property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and a callee that successfully accepts all transferFrom low-level calls, C.transfer(...) always returns true; the mutant returns false for those same successful calls, breaking this rule.

For any non-empty _tos array and a callee that accepts the low-level transferFrom calls (i.e., the external calls succeed), C.transfer(...) always returns true; the mutant returns false for those same successful calls, so the property (successful transfer implies returned true) is violated by the mutant.

For any non-empty _tos array and a callee that successfully responds to the low-level transferFrom calls, C.transfer(...) always returns true; the mutant returns false for those same successful calls, so the property (successful completion implies returned true) is violated by the mutant.

For any non-empty _tos array and any inputs, if all low-level calls to caddress.transferFrom(from, _tos[i], value) succeed (i.e., transfer completes without revert), then C.transfer(...) returns true; the mutant returning false for the same successful execution breaks this rule.

For any non-empty _tos array and any callee that successfully accepts the composed transferFrom calls, C.transfer(...) completes (does not revert) and returns true; the mutant still completes but returns false, so the property is that a successful non-reverting transfer call returns true — which the mutant violates for some inputs.
